reason: Both halves hold. Ollama: the installed SDK's Message.ToolCall has no id field and drops one even if the server sends it (verified), so the adapter always emits tool_call_id=''; ackHostAction returns early on an empty id and ActionAckRequest requires min_length=1, so on the store's default provider every host action is rewritten to 'dispatched_unconfirmed' after the 0.8 s grace. Gemini: ids fall back to f'{name}_{index}' with the index reset per stream, and action_ledger is process-global with a 600 s TTL and no per-run scoping, so a repeated host action in a later round/run finds the earlier 'applied' ack and the model is told the new action applied. No normalization exists anywhere in the runtime. Ollama tool turns also omit tool_name although the SDK Message has it.
